arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued the Federal Arbitration Act provides a clear path for enforcement.
He stated that other federal statutes do not automatically invalidate these agreements.
David Ortiz noted that approximately sixty million employees have mandatory arbitration contracts.
He emphasized the widespread impact of these agreements on the private workforce.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether the Federal Arbitration Act overrides the National Labor Relations Act. The dispute centers on mandatory individual arbitration clauses in employment contracts. the sides that brought the case seek to enforce these agreements. the opposing sides seek to void them as illegal restraints on concerted activity.

paragraphs: This dispute determines whether millions of workers can join collective legal actions. It defines the scope of federal labor protections against mandatory arbitration clauses. The outcome shapes the balance between contract enforcement and collective bargaining rights.
